claude_proposed_widenings.name: dissolve_adhesive
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Universal Solvent dissolves adhesive bonds — both mundane adhesives and magical ones created by Sovereign Glue's bond_objects atom — per ounce applied to the surface. No existing effect atom covers ending a bond_objects effect or dissolving general adhesive contact. The bond_objects atom comment in types.ts explicitly defers these counter-item semantics: 'those counter-items carry the dispelling semantics in their own content, not this atom.' A new atom is therefore required in the surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each ounce instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches, including Sovereign Glue.

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_universal_solvent.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
